items.question: Under UAE Personal Status Law for Muslim couples, within how many days must a husband document a divorce before the competent court?
items.gold: The husband must document the divorce before the competent court within a maximum of fifteen (15) days from the date it occurs.
items.fact: Husband must document divorce within 15 days

items.question: In the UAE, is Khula, a separation requested by the wife in return for compensation, considered an irrevocable divorce?
items.gold: Yes, Khula is considered an irrevocable divorce.
items.fact: Khula is considered an irrevocable divorce
